terms.meaning: `apps/api`, the workflows behind HTTP, and the system's public interface.

a person's ask of a run over HTTP, one route per command of the orchestrator's table: another try, or with `"round": true` another round of the loop the step closes, on `POST /api/namespaces/:namespace/runs/:name/steps/:step/retry`; an approval at a gate, or of a loop out of rounds as it stands, on `POST /api/namespaces/:namespace/runs/:name/steps/:step/approve`; the new revisions, or with `"base": true` a merge of the base into a loop's work, on `POST /api/namespaces/:namespace/runs/:name/refresh`: named actions of objects' `Api`, served by `apps/api/src/objects/runs.ts`, each handler calling the orchestrator's entry by its exported name with its typed `input`.

terms.meaning: what comes with Nemia, as the api says it: a skill read `from: 'builtin'` (the folder `BUILTIN_SKILLS`, the orchestrator package's skills folder, each found by name, last, by an agent that gives it), the `builtin` servers of a factory's servers read (`BUILTIN_SERVERS`, `packages/agent-orchestrator/servers/`) and the `builtin` rule of an agent's auto list. A builtin skill is a Skill of origin `builtin`, read at `/api/namespaces/<namespace>/skills/<name>?origin=builtin` and copied into your library by `POST /api/namespaces/default/skills/<name>/copy`.

terms.meaning: who a request is from, as the api resolves it before any router is reached (`callerGate`, `apps/api/src/caller/caller.ts`): the person where it presents no `Authorization`, an agent's session by the session token it presents as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, asked of the orchestrator (`sessionCaller`). A token refused, or a header that is no bearer, is a 401 `Unauthorized` with its reason on any route. A handler reads it as `caller` (`Served`, `apps/api/src/layer.ts`), and a proposal's and a delegation's handlers hand it to the orchestrator's programs (`apps/api/src/proposals/`), which judge it: a refusal by who calls is a 403 `Forbidden` with its reason.
the `nemia …` line the api hands the board for a person to copy.

terms.meaning: the sentence a generated route's 202 answer adds, under `hint`, when its body said a value under a former spelling (`renamedValues`, the run core's `RENAMED_VALUES`): it names the value to send now, as the CLI's hint names the line to type. Absent where the body said nothing renamed.
a run's result is on its base, as the package asks it: the `landed` key of a hold's wait, of a run waited on and of a run handed as context, and the decision's `land it`.

terms.meaning: the transport an MCP server of a factory's `.mcp.json` declares, as a harness loads one (`stdio`, `http`, `sse`, the runtime's `MCP_TRANSPORTS`), or `unknown` for any other word, the word as written quoted in the server's not-asked sentence. A server with a command and no type is `stdio`.

a metric's kind as Effect names it (`Metric.Metric.Type`: Counter, Frequency, Gauge, Histogram, Summary), read from the api's own registry; a kind the api keeps no value of is answered with its name and type alone.

the api's description of the run object in OpenAPI 3.1, generated from the package's Schema and served on `GET /openapi/v3/nemia/v1`, with the routes of its sub-resources as the command table gives them. A client's types for the object are generated from it; a sub-resource's answer has no Schema in it yet.
what each step and each try carries at the api: its `phase` and its `reason`, the codes a reader groups and compares, and its `message`, the sentence a person reads and nothing compares.

the `?selector=` query of a read of runs or cards (`/api/listing`, `/api/stats`) and of the feed (`GET /api/feed/stream`): a selector of their labels in the orchestrator's grammar (`team=core`, `team in (core,infra)`, `!team`), given again for another, of which one must take a run or a card; handed to the entry as `selector` (`apps/api/src/labels/selector.ts`), and a malformed one a 422 naming the key. The RunList (`GET /api/runs`, `GET /api/namespaces/:namespace/runs`) takes `labelSelector` in its place, and reads `?selector=` as retired.
a try's `cause` on a step's tries (`StepTry.cause`): why the try was moved behind, one of the run core's `TryCause`, and null on the current try.
a check's verdict at the api, as codes, its `result` and its `exit`, on a step and on its `StepCheck`, null where no check judged it; the word a person reads for it is the board's to draw.

`waitingOnYou`: the steps of a run that wait on a person, in order; `waitingOnYouWords`, the same steps as `nemia ls` names them (`approve plan` for a step at its gate); and, on a run's `--after` wait and its hold, `waitingOnYou` whether only a person ends it.

retired.card: 4c: the words of what waits on you are `waitingOnYouWords`, and whether a wait is yours `waitingOnYou`

terms.meaning: the MCP endpoint of the api, `POST /mcp` (`apps/api/src/mcp/port.ts`): Streamable HTTP, stateless, a Hono route beside the OpenAPI routes and the one route that is no endpoint of `objects`' `Api`. It needs a person's token, and serves the port tools by calling the `Api`'s own endpoints in-process with the caller's `Authorization`, so every refusal is the api's own.

a tool of the port, one for each endpoint link of the command table (`served`, read by `toolsOf`): named by its verb (spaces as `_`) or its link's `as`, described by the verb's help and usage, its input the endpoint's path, query and payload as one JSON Schema, and its `readOnlyHint` and `destructiveHint` from the verb's class and the endpoint's method (`toolHints`, `apps/api/src/mcp/hints.ts`); generated in `apps/api/src/mcp/tools.ts`, never listed by hand. A call is sent with its link's `query` for each key it leaves out and a page of `PORT_PAGE` where its endpoint takes `limit`; a list that answers a `Table` is answered as its lines, printed by `objects`' `tableLines` as `nemia` prints them; and its answer is held under the answer bound.

the most characters a port tool answers at once, `ANSWER_BOUND` (`apps/api/src/mcp/bound.ts`), its text and any `structuredContent`'s JSON counted together, under the 50,000 characters past which Claude Code saves a tool's result to a file: a page past it is asked again at most half as long, and any other answer past it is refused with how to narrow it, never cut (`answerFit`, proved by `apps/api/contracts/answer-fit.contract.ts`).
